s1.syndrome_frame: A man in his 30s with a left cervical lesion and subsequent lymph node metastasis with extracapsular extension, and locoregional recurrence with skin metastasis
salient_findings: Lymph node metastasis with extracapsular extension
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 30s
Patient has phototype 3 skin
Patient has occupational sun exposure
Patient has fewer than 50 nevi
Initial lesion had Breslow depth of 2.6 mm
Initial lesion had no ulceration
Initial lesion had 7 mitoses/mm2
Patient is BRAF V600E mutation positive
Initial staging CT scan, ultrasonography, lactate dehydrogenase and S-100 protein levels were normal
Selective sentinel node biopsy findings were negative

shortlist.label: Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of a left cervical lesion with subsequent lymph node metastasis and locoregional recurrence, and is BRAF V600E mutation positive

shortlist.label: Spitzoid Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's initial lesion had a Breslow depth of 2.6 mm and 7 mitoses/mm2, which could be consistent with a spitzoid melanoma

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's lesion had a history of recurrence and metastasis, which could be consistent with a desmoplastic melanoma

shortlist.label: Mucosal Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely, mucosal melanoma can occur in the head and neck region and should be considered given the patient's cervical lesion

shortlist.label: Clear Cell Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: This rare tumor can mimic melanoma and should be considered in the differential diagnosis given the patient's presentation

raw.rationale: The patient's initial lesion had a Breslow depth of 2.6 mm, 7 mitoses/mm2, and was BRAF V600E mutation positive, all of which are characteristic of melanoma. Additionally, the patient developed lymph node metastasis with extracapsular extension and locoregional recurrence with skin metastasis, which is consistent with the aggressive behavior of melanoma.

rejected.label: Spitzoid Melanoma
rejected.why: Spitzoid melanoma typically has a more favorable prognosis and less aggressive behavior than what is described in the case.

rejected.label: Desmoplastic Melanoma
rejected.why: Desmoplastic melanoma is a rare subtype of melanoma that typically presents with a deeper Breslow depth and more pronounced desmoplastic reaction, which is not described in the case.

rejected.label: Mucosal Melanoma
rejected.why: Mucosal melanoma arises from mucosal surfaces, which is not consistent with the description of a cervical lesion in the case.

rejected.label: Clear Cell Sarcoma
rejected.why: Clear cell sarcoma is a rare tumor that typically affects the soft tissues of the extremities, which is not consistent with the description of a cervical lesion in the case.
